rodin_lk_unlock_kit - signing key info
======================================

[IMPORTANT: this private key is intentionally public]
file: rodin_unlock_priv.pem

This is NOT a leaked Xiaomi/MediaTek key. It is a key generated for this project
and published on purpose, so that anyone can sign unlock tokens for the modified
LK images in this repository, fully offline.

It only affects devices that have been flashed with the modified images in
images/. It does not unlock stock firmware and it does not affect any other
device or service.

If you want a signing key that only you control, do not use the prebuilt images;
generate your own key and rebuild the images. See docs/CUSTOM_KEY.md.
